expressionErrors.title: Also report brackets that do not pair inside {{ }} and {% %} (off by default)

projectExtensions.title: Complete project filters, functions and tests
projectExtensions.description: Complete and navigate to the filters, functions and tests the project registers in src/, app/ and lib/ (outside Symfony projects)

diagnostics.title: Report unclosed tags, unexpected end tags and unterminated delimiters

hover.title: Hover documentation
hover.description: For core Twig tags and filters, and for macros defined in the current template.

tagOpen.title: Tag opening delimiter
tagOpen.description: Starts a tag, as in {% if %}. Change only if your Twig environment uses custom delimiters.

tagClose.title: Tag closing delimiter
tagClose.description: Ends a tag, as in {% if %}. Change only if your Twig environment uses custom delimiters.

variableOpen.title: Variable opening delimiter
variableOpen.description: Starts a printed expression, as in {{ name }}. Change only if your Twig environment uses custom delimiters.

variableClose.title: Variable closing delimiter
variableClose.description: Ends a printed expression, as in {{ name }}. Change only if your Twig environment uses custom delimiters.

commentOpen.title: Comment opening delimiter
commentOpen.description: Starts a comment, as in {# note #}. Change only if your Twig environment uses custom delimiters.

commentClose.title: Comment closing delimiter
commentClose.description: Ends a comment, as in {# note #}. Change only if your Twig environment uses custom delimiters.

formatterEnabled.title: Format Twig files with Twig-CS-Fixer
formatterEnabled.description: Fixes spacing around delimiters, operators and punctuation. Needs PHP and the Twig-CS-Fixer PHAR path below.

formatterPhar.title: Twig-CS-Fixer PHAR path
formatterPhar.description: Absolute path to the official Twig-CS-Fixer 4.1.1 PHAR. Other versions or modified files are refused.

staticTemplateReferences.title: Occurrence highlights and rename
staticTemplateReferences.description: Go to Definition, highlighting, occurrence counts and Rename for names written literally in templates. Rename shows the changes and asks before editing.

templateNamespaces.title: Twig loader namespaces
templateNamespaces.description: Map @namespace/name.twig template names to project-relative directories (no .., no absolute paths; at most 32 entries). A namespace mapped twice is ignored. In Symfony projects, namespaces from twig.paths in config/packages/twig.yaml, its when@dev/prod/test blocks and config/packages/{dev,prod,test}/twig.yaml are added too, unless this setting names the namespace or the config maps it to different directories.
